name: zsnd_cd_stop
description: zSndCd::Stop stops ready CD playback through MCI, clears playback mode, resets cached track state, and returns zero when CD audio is not ready.
known_limits: Tier S verification is accepted by the zsnd_cd_stop VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a26f0 validates the ready-flag guard, MCI_STOP command 0x808 with flags 0x02, low-word device id, ReportMciError line 0x10e on MCI failure, last-play-mode clear, ResetTrackState call, and return values.
The native smoke verifies not-ready behavior and the patched-MCI ready path including command id, flags, cached track-state reset, and last-play-mode clear.
